title: OpenLanes plan state
description: state.json in a .plans folder: the harness's stages, the agents' signatures, and the messages between agents. Written only through openlanes, never by hand.

state.description: The last state the harness moved the folder to. The folder name is authoritative.

moves.description: How many times openlanes has moved the folder to another state. A settling stage notes the count, so a later move, even away and back, is seen.

quality_ask.description: R4's question, desired_codebase_quality, asked once per project on the first review-ok-not-perfect pull request while .openlanes.yml has no key; settled when a person answers.

resume_until.description: Until when a 💣 on this plan does not halt the run: the control room's Resume anyway for 24 h.

finished.description: When and how the plan finished: staff-reviewer approved it, or its pull request merged. A merge replaces an approval. Cleared when an agent starts on the plan again, or a person rejects it.

stages.description: One record per dispatch of an agent's round, in dispatch order, written by the harness.

moves.description: The plan's moves when this round settled.

session.description: The CLI's session id for this round, as soon as its stream named it. `claude --resume <id>`, run from `cwd`, carries it on by hand.

cwd.description: The checkout the round ran in. A claude session is found only from the directory it ran in.

run.description: Deprecated: written by releases before 021.00, read so their crashes still resume. The harness pid and host now live in the run's state file outside the repository.

signatures.description: Ledger lines, written by agents through `openlanes state sign`.

rulings.description: arbitrator's rulings, written by the engine from the agent's ruling block, never by the agent (M7). Absent on plans never arbitrated.

headings.description: A struck id's heading, as the arbitrator quoted it: ids restart at F1 in every review.

review.description: The round of staff-reviewer's review the struck and critical ids belong to.

last-known-state.description: One resume record per agent, last one wins: written by the agent through `openlanes state resume`, or by the harness when the agent could not.

merge_risk.description: deploy-assessor's verdicts for this visit to Completed (P1, P4), by pull request number, and when the engine rebased a sibling onto main (P5). Stands only while moves still equals the count it was written at.

memory.description: Each agent's journal (M2): what it printed as one-line JSON while it worked, kept by the harness, the only writer. Entries are numbered 1 up across an agent's rounds, in order; a later one wins.

rounds.description: Keyed by the agent's journal round on this plan, 1 up across runs and states; not the dispatcher's round, which restarts in every run.

conversions.description: Questions in blocked.md the engine rewrote into lettered choices (D9), and ones it tried and could not, with the text as the agent wrote it.

digest.description: SHA256 of original, so the same text is never sent twice.

note.description: Why the model's answer was rejected.

extensions.description: The harness asking a person for more time or another round for one agent (E1), and how each request was settled.

number.description: The n of Xn, unique in this plan.

state.description: The status key the agent was working when it ran out.

limit.description: What ran out: the round's clock, or the agent's rounds.

answer.description: a) one more round, b) ten more minutes, c) twenty more minutes.

by.description: Who answered: a person's user name, or auto.

grant.description: live: the running clock was extended; round: one more round.

seconds.description: Extra seconds on the clock the grant gives.

closed.description: Why it was settled without an answer.

spent.description: A round grant's seconds were given to the round that ran on them.

messages.description: What agents on this plan said to each other, through `openlanes mail send`.

id.description: Written by `openlanes mail send`, so a message drained from Redis is recognised by identity, not by a number another copy of this file may also have given out. Absent on messages written before ids existed.

read.description: "yes" once its recipient ran `openlanes mail ack`. Absent on messages written before acks existed, which read as "no".

command.description: The id of the page's command that sent it (plan 004, W13), so a redelivered command appends nothing twice.

lastKnownState.description: Where one agent stood when it was interrupted. No pid, token or exit field exists: those describe one machine's run and stay in openlanes-state.json.

round.description: The dispatcher's round it was printed in.

state.description: The state the plan was in when the round started.

overrides.description: On an override: the number of the entry it overturns.

ref.description: The blocked.md question this records, written by the harness.

answer.description: A person's answer to that question, written by the harness.
